storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Steampunk Story
storyTemplate.description: A steampunk start: board an airship under pressure and repair the first mechanical failure before launch.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Steam rolls across the airship dock as the Cloudlark strains against its mooring chains.

A pressure bell clangs somewhere inside the engine cowling. Dockhands shout over the hiss of valves, and a brass gauge near the boarding ramp jitters into the red.

The ship is scheduled to launch. The engine disagrees.
